page.content:
The drivers' title Fangio, Schumacher, Hamilton, and Verstappen chased.

How World Drivers' Championship connects

  • Topic: Formula 1 — The World Drivers' Championship is Formula 1's individual title.
  • Faction: FIA — The FIA awards the World Drivers' Championship.
  • Character: Michael Schumacher — Schumacher's seven Drivers' Championships reset the career standard.
  • Character: Lewis Hamilton — Hamilton matched Schumacher on seven World Drivers' Championships.
  • Character: Juan Manuel Fangio — Fangio's five Drivers' Championships were the record Schumacher broke.
  • Character: Max Verstappen — Verstappen's title run is the Drivers' Championship of the 2020s.

What is World Drivers' Championship?

The World Drivers' Championship is the FIA title awarded each season to the highest-scoring driver, the prize that makes Senna, Schumacher, Hamilton, and Verstappen comparable across eras.

Key threads lead to Formula 1, FIA, Michael Schumacher, Lewis Hamilton, Juan Manuel Fangio and Max Verstappen.
